items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: I don't know anything about him.

ctx.x: Well, and a lot of real drummers that play in it every day, they beat from their toe.

Yeah. You see? Yeah. In regard to some of the early, Thomas, do you remember King Oliver, or Joe Oliver as they call him? No. Did you ever hear him when you were a kid? No. He left, I guess, when you were ten years old. I imagine.
He should have been. I don't know anything about him.
